scriptLines: query: 'SELECT CAST(a.admission_id AS INT) AS admission_id_bk, CAST(COALESCE(dp.paciente_key, pd.paciente_key, 1) AS INT) AS paciente_key, CAST(COALESCE(dd.departamento_key, 1) AS INT) AS departamento_key, CAST(COALESCE(ddiag.diagnostico_key, dgd.diagnostico_key, 1) AS INT) AS diagnostico_key, CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), a.admission_date, 112) AS INT) AS fecha_ingreso_key, CAST(CASE WHEN a.discharge_date IS NOT NULL THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), a.discharge_date, 112) ELSE NULL END AS INT) AS fecha_alta_key, CAST(a.attending_doctor_id AS INT) AS medico_id, CAST(CASE WHEN a.discharge_date IS NOT NULL THEN DATEDIFF(DAY, a.admission_date, a.discharge_date) ELSE NULL END AS INT) AS dias_estancia, CAST(1 AS INT) AS conteo_admisiones FROM silver.admissions a LEFT JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 paciente_key FROM gold.dim_paciente WHERE patient_id_bk = -1) pd ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 diagnostico_key FROM gold.dim_diagnostico WHERE codigo_icd = \'SIN_DIAG\') dgd ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN gold.dim_paciente dp ON a.patient_id = dp.patient_id_bk LEFT JOIN gold.dim_departamento dd ON a.department = dd.nombre_departamento LEFT JOIN (SELECT d.admission_id, d.icd_code, COALESCE(d.diagnosis_description, N\'Sin descripción\') AS diagnosis_description, COALESCE(d.severity, \'No Especificada\') AS severity, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.admission_id ORDER BY CASE COALESCE(d.severity, \'No Especificada\') WHEN \'Critical\' THEN 1 WHEN \'Severe\' THEN 2 WHEN \'Moderate\' THEN 3 WHEN \'Mild\' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, d.diagnosis_id ASC) AS rn FROM silver.diagnoses d) dpr ON a.admission_id = dpr.admission_id AND dpr.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN gold.dim_diagnostico ddiag ON dpr.icd_code = ddiag.codigo_icd AND dpr.diagnosis_description = ddiag.descripcion_patologia AND dpr.severity = ddiag.nivel_severidad',
